items.text: Keep your options open and move the whole system forward.
What Honua replaces, row by row
Import services and data, and convert code where a tool supports the pattern. Move one workflow at a time and keep the tools and integrations your people rely on.
Describe the map or app you need, refine it in conversation, and watch the composition change as you go. Extend it through the SDKs, the APIs, and AI workflows that run under your permissions.
Scale the work, not idle infrastructure.
Serving and processing get their own capacity. Run supported workloads on serverless containers, autoscaling clusters, or on-demand batch compute instead of one server sized for the busiest hour.

Make changes with confidence. Use AI to help configure services, investigate failures, and prepare deployments and upgrades. The Ops Inbox brings findings and suggested fixes into one place. Review and approve supported changes with preflight and recovery checks, Git-backed history, and rollback where supported.
